prompt.text:
A message from a customer:
<message>
Our production checkout has been returning 500s for every card payment since 09:14 UTC. Nothing is going through. I have three customers on the phone right now. Please help.
</message>

criteria.yes: The customer needs an answer today
criteria.no: The message can wait for the normal queue

team.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

severity.instructions: How severe is the reported issue?

levels.label: Workaround available
levels.description: A task fails, but another way works

levels.label: Fully blocked
levels.description: A task fails with no workaround
